key_insight: Symbal detects systematic captioning errors by linking recurring misalignments to specific visual features in image-text datasets.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical auditing tool for large multimodal datasets and MLLM outputs without needing access to the underlying model.
method: Dual-stage pipeline using off-the-shelf foundation models
Identifies candidate systematic misalignments in vision-language datasets
Summarizes detected error patterns in natural language
evidence_signal: Evaluated on SymbalBench with 1.7M image-text pairs across 420 datasets from natural and medical domains; Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-dependent, so real-world deployment may require domain-specific validation and careful review of false positives/negatives.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
